estimates.basis: Estimates from this repo's own benchmark (tools/bench.py, 4 cores/16 GB sandbox): ~1.1 KB RAM and ~25 microseconds per CSV row => 1M rows ~1.1 GB, ~25 s. Linear extrapolation beyond 2.6M rows is NOT measured.
estimates.this_tier: 3M rows ~3.3 GB, ~75 s (measured 2.6M rows: 3 GB peak, ~66 s). Above 3M rows would be extrapolation: not offered
